title: Socio-Traffic Thermodynamics: Public Landing and Metadata Refresh
description: Claim-bounded reduced-surrogate archive for Socio-Traffic Thermodynamics. This v0.3.2 refresh reorganizes the public repository landing page, GitHub Pages entry point, claim-boundary metadata, and search/discovery files while preserving the v0.3.1 integrated manuscript as the scientific content baseline. It does not claim real-world traffic prediction, traffic-policy validation, deployment-ready route guidance, or a universal congestion solution.
notes: License terms are source-defined in LICENSE and LICENSE_EVALUATION_ONLY.txt. No DOI is specified in this metadata; allow Zenodo to assign archive identifiers from GitHub releases.
